props.name: defaultSnapPoint
props.description: The initial snap point value when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger that the drawer is associated with. This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open drawer.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Whether to prevent the drawer from closing on outside presses. For non-modal drawers, this also prevents the drawer from closing when focus moves outside of it.

props.name: handle
props.description: A handle to associate the drawer with a trigger. If specified, allows detached triggers to control the drawer's open state. Can be created with the Drawer.createHandle() method.

props.name: modal
props.description: Determines if the drawer enters a modal state when open. - `true`: user interaction is limited to just the drawer: focus is trapped, document page scroll is locked, and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled. - `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed. - `'trap-focus'`: focus is trapped inside the drawer, but document page scroll is not locked and pointer interactions outside of it remain enabled.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge the panel anchors to. Also selects the swipe-to-dismiss direction (`top` → up, `right` → right, `bottom` → down, `left` → left).

props.name: snapPoint

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Snap points used to position the drawer. Use numbers between 0 and 1 to represent fractions of the viewport height, numbers greater than 1 as pixel values, or strings in `px`/`rem` units (for example, `'148px'` or `'30rem'`).

props.name: snapToSequentialPoints
props.description: Disables velocity-based snap skipping so drag distance determines the next snap point.
